tldr: The prescribed clipped-histogram hull has a rank-aware certified sufficient cone on the entire fixed H\"older ball. Define \(\ell_n=M_n\exp(-C_qK_n)\) and the exact discarded-rank budget \(d_n=\lfloor(1-\pi_n)M_n\rfloor\). With the unchanged eventual envelope \(\log M_n\le aK_n\) for a fixed finite \(a>0\), the condition \((\ell_n-d_n)/\sqrt{\ell_n}\to+\infty\) gives uniform causal coverage tending to one and expected length of order \(K_n/n+n^{-1/2}\). The former two logarithmic margins, including eventual no discard, remain a sufficient corollary. The genuinely filtering witness \(A=B=45{,}000{,}000\) is unchanged: \(M_n=2^{AK_n}\), \(\pi_n=1-M_n^{-1}\), \(k=M_n-1\), and rank budget one; all ties can reduce the actual discarded count to zero. The \(A>B\) families retain growing rank budgets. One same-class sinusoidal sequence has coverage tending to zero if either logarithmic budget is \(o(K_n)\), independently of the other coordinate. Both failures transfer to the specified native Algorithm 1 union subclass. The rank condition is exact for the displayed variance certificate, not the unresolved true coverage frontier; optimal exponent constants and finite critical-window limits remain unresolved.
